content: Official Microsoft ZoomIt and Windows Snipping Tool documentation reinforces output and environment expectations: capture a selected region, window, full screen, or display; save to file and/or copy to clipboard; support common PNG/JPG/WebP outputs where practical; and expose customizable global hotkeys from a tray or menu-bar app. Microsoft documents multi-monitor capture and ZoomIt also addresses full-screen presentation workflows and display mirroring. Epic Pen version history shows cross-platform implementations must account for per-monitor movement, virtual desktops/Spaces, differing display scale, cursor and fading-ink offsets, input latency, stylus pressure, and macOS Accessibility permissions. v1 should make display targeting and permission state clear.
